task.title: See a family's page
task.shortdesc: Read the page of a family, and add the marriage to it.

prereq.p: Make the family first. shows how. Its page opens when you save it.

context.p: This page uses the family of Patrick Brontë and Maria Branwell.

step.cmd: Read the page of the family.

stepresult.p: The title names both partners, such as Patrick Brontë & Maria Branwell. Under it, a line says No events recorded for this family. until a marriage is added. The chip that starts with names the family too.
The page has parts for , , and , and a part for notes. draws the family.

step.cmd: Scroll to the foot of the page and choose .

stepresult.p: The page turns into a form.

step.cmd: In , type 29 in , choose December in and type 1812 in .

info.p: A line under the date starts Reads as. Check it says what you meant. says more.

step.cmd: In , type St Oswald's church, Guiseley, Yorkshire.

info.p: Places you typed before are offered under the box. says more.

stepresult.p: The line under the title now reads Marriage · 29 December 1812 · St Oswald's church, Guiseley, Yorkshire.

result.p: The marriage shows in on the page of the family. The tree of each partner shows the year, such as m. 1812.
The chip beside counts its sources. shows how to add one.
result.note: If you typed a marriage date on the family form, check that this page shows it under . If the line still says No events recorded for this family., add the marriage with , in the steps of this page.
